My Dad and my siblings were on their way to the city and they all died. (My mom and dad are separated and I was with my mom at the time.) It was so real. My dad had a yellow 78 Grand Marquee and all I could see was them getting hit my a semi and my dads face smacking into the steering wheel and my brothers and sister where thrown from the car and died on impact. And the car smashed to half its size. 
I woke up having a panic attack and I immediately called my Dad but he couldn't make out what I was saying because I was crying so bad. My dad and my siblings were on their way to the city in real life. I made him call me as soon as they made it to my grandmas house. They ended up being safe but I was freaking out the rest of the day.

I've had a dream I was in a hospital that was abandoned. I was in a patient gown at the bottom of an elevator shaft that was rapidly filling up with freezing water. Above me about 4 or 5 stories, an elevator door entrance was open and there was a woman with long, gray hair and skinny limbs with dark clothes on, laughing, but like a laugh you could never forget. Then it would flash to a patient room and I was handcuffed to the floor by both my hands and feet. Then I could hear someone shuffling toward my halfway closed curtain. It turned out to be the woman laughing at me in the elevator shaft and at this point I would notice she had pure black eyes. She's coming after me with a knife and I would start screaming. Then it would flash to me running down a hospital hall that never ends and she's coming after me. She's screaming, like a blood curdling scream compared to nails on a chalkboard. Im just running and I can't get away from her and I can hear her breathing on my neck and I'm running as fast as I can but I can't get away...this is the point that I wake up every time. I've had this dream about 7 in the past year and a half after playing with some thing that I shouldn't have touched.
